{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check premises
print("Status values and counts:")
print(df['status'].value_counts())

print("\nRevenue column dtype:")
print(df['revenue'].dtype)

print("\nFirst few revenue values (as string):")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for sentinel values in revenue
print("\nNumber of rows with revenue = '999999.99':")
print((df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for -1 in customer_age (just to be thorough, though not in scope)
print("\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age:")
print((df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
